blocks.text: Every submission stays private until Henry Onyx reviews and approves it.
A listing still waiting on required documents is not published.
If a listing needs a site inspection, it stays private until the inspection is finished.
A listing can stay in review until the owner's identity or ownership is confirmed.
Listings not managed by Henry Onyx are run by their owner or agent, who remains responsible after first contact.

blocks.text: What makes a Henry Onyx-managed property different?
Viewings and maintenance for managed homes are coordinated by Henry Onyx.
Can I submit a property before my media is perfect?
Yes. Henry Onyx may ask for better photos before the listing is approved.
Henry Onyx confirms the time with you and sends a reminder before the viewing.
Yes. Offices, retail, hospitality and industrial spaces can be listed and searched.
Can Henry Onyx manage a property after occupancy?
Yes. Managed services can include rent follow-up, maintenance, inspections and owner reporting.
